description: Consumer Airfare Report: Table 5 - Detailed Fare Information For Highest and Lowest Fare Markets Under 750 Miles is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Aviation", published or maintained by Department of Transportation Office of the Assistant Secretary for Aviation and International Affairs. Provides detailed fare information for highest and lowest fare markets under 750 miles. For a more complete explanation, please read the introductory information at the beginning of Table 5 itself in the report (. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Aviation". It has 29 columns, among them Geocoded_City2 (address), tbl5pk, Geocoded_City2 (city), Geocoded_City1 (city), fare_inc_x3paxsh, tbl. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last data update. Attribution given: Department of Transportation Office of the Assistant Secretary for Aviation and International Affairs. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
